query: (Cathay MD) Build a model to organise/optimise routes and service so Overall Rating > 7.

per_column.name: review_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Sentiment derived from the free-text review is an independent signal about the reviewer's experience that plausibly correlates with whether Overall Rating > 7, without being a deterministic function of the rating itself.

per_column.name: weakest_attribute
per_column.rationale: The lowest-scoring sub-attribute is derived from the component ratings (Seat Comfort, Food, etc.), which are separate from the Overall Rating focus. It carries predictive signal about overall satisfaction and is not a restatement of the target.

per_column.name: service_score_gap
per_column.rationale: A gap/spread among the individual service sub-scores is a legitimate feature built from the component ratings, distinct from the overall rating, and can plausibly predict whether the overall exceeds 7.

per_column.name: hub_route
per_column.rationale: Whether the route touches a hub is an external structural attribute of the flight, knowable before the outcome and plausibly related to satisfaction. Highly imbalanced (714 vs 30), so limited leverage, but still a valid predictor.

per_column.name: rating_vs_class_avg
per_column.rationale: This is the Overall Rating minus the class average, i.e. a direct affine transform of the focus variable. Knowing it (plus the class mean) essentially recovers the rating and thus the target; it leaks/restates the outcome.

per_column.name: priority_action
per_column.rationale: Categories like 'on_track'/'high_impact' appear to be derived from the rating relative to a threshold (the >7 goal), making them a post-hoc function of the outcome itself rather than an independent predictor.

judge.rationale: Four columns (review_sentiment, weakest_attribute, service_score_gap, hub_route) are legitimate predictors drawn from text and component-level ratings, offering genuine signal beyond the raw columns. However, rating_vs_class_avg is an affine transform of Overall Rating and priority_action appears derived from the >7 threshold, both constituting leakage/restatement of the focus. The valid features overlap heavily with information already in the component-rating columns, and hub_route is severely imbalanced, so net additional predictive leverage is moderate.
